Why Masala Code

Not fusion. Focus. Familiar food that tastes extraordinary.

  • True to each region — authentic flavours, sourced with care.
  • For every guest — vegetarian, vegan and Jain-friendly options; gluten-free and lactose-free choices.
  • Celebrations welcome — kitty parties, family celebrations, corporate events; special banquet menu.
  • Part of The House of V — a hospitality collective in Indore, with Atelier V and Fabric.
  • Comfort included — wheelchair accessible, with valet parking.
  • Takeaway available — order direct, pick up from the restaurant.

“In every street corner, in every spice blend there is Indore.”
